name: union_gate_synth
description: v0.2 gate, part 1: every optional field (scalars and optional record-table columns) of the synthetic default site at 10k pages (frozen seed 1) appears in its template's union page, as an annotated candidate at the field's structural path showing one of its values. Also reports union-page tokens per template. Runs ingest -> cluster -> analyze -> union; no LLM.
